ACHERON-SLASHED_DREAM.title: Slashed Dream
ACHERON-SLASHED_DREAM.description: Acheron's core counter. Accumulated by playing [gold]Vermilion Seal[/gold] / [gold]Moon Slash[/gold] etc. When Slashed Dream reaches 9, you can play [gold]Draw Sword[/gold] to trigger a [gold]Final Strike[/gold].
ACHERON-CRIMSON_KNOT.title: Crimson Knot
ACHERON-CRIMSON_KNOT.description: Enemy resource bank debuff. Can be consumed by certain cards to deal bonus damage, gain Block, gain Energy, or apply Vulnerable.
ACHERON-FINAL_STRIKE.title: Final Strike
ACHERON-FINAL_STRIKE.description:
Vanishes after being played or at end of turn.
A decisive strike triggered by [gold]Draw Sword[/gold].
ACHERON-GUIDANCE.title: Guidance
ACHERON-GUIDANCE.description: Probability trigger mechanic. Each Guidance card rolls once at 20% × multiplier chance. On trigger, executes the card's Guidance branch effect. Each [gold]Eternal Night[/gold] in hand adds +5% chance.
ACHERON-KARMA.title: Karma
ACHERON-KARMA.description: Status card. Unplayable. At the end of your turn, it is burned and deals 3 damage to you.
ACHERON-FATE_END.title: Fate End
ACHERON-FATE_END.description: Status card. Unplayable. At the end of your turn, it is burned and you gain 1 [gold]Slashed Dream[/gold]. Can be consumed by certain cards.
ACHERON-ETERNAL_NIGHT.title: Eternal Night
ACHERON-ETERNAL_NIGHT.description: Status card. Unplayable. Does not naturally vanish. While in hand, each copy adds +5% [gold]Guidance[/gold] chance. Can be consumed by certain cards.
ACHERON-VOID_MASTERY.title: Void Mastery
ACHERON-VOID_MASTERY.description: When an Ethereal card with this tag is burned at end of turn without being played, it triggers an additional effect.
ACHERON-EIDOLON.title: Eidolon System
ACHERON-EIDOLON.description:
After each combat, you can skip the card reward to draw 1 [color=purple]Eidolon[/color]. 30% chance to obtain. Max 6 [color=purple]Eidolons[/color] unlocked.
(Author's note: don't get too greedy chasing Eidolons and forget to pick up defense cards.)
ACHERON-ASTRAY.title: Astray
ACHERON-ASTRAY.description: You know — the lost ones are the strongest. When a card enters your hand, it has a [blue]50%[/blue] chance to go [gold]Astray[/gold], unlocking an extra effect.
